name: Rimier Rice Dispenser
description: Press-type rice dispenser that holds 10 kg (20 jin) of rice. Fully sealed and moisture-proof, with a slanted opening, one-touch dispensing, an insect-repellent compartment and a silicone sealing ring. About 27 × 27 × 47.5 cm.

name: Furniture Movers
description: Adjustable furniture movers on wheels. Slide them under a washing machine, fridge, sofa, cabinet or table to roll it across the floor without lifting.

name: Towel Roll (Small, 20 pcs)
description: Roll of 20 microfibre cleaning cloths. Tear one off when you need it, for the kitchen, bathroom or car. Colours vary.

name: Acrylic Laundry Basket
description: Clear acrylic laundry basket with a lid, wheels and a pull handle.

name: Plastic Laundry Basket
description: Laundry basket with a flower-pattern design, a lid, a carry handle and wheels.

name: Refrigerator Organizer (Small)
description: 5 litre clear fridge organizer with a lid and handle. Keeps fruit and vegetables tidy and easy to see.

name: Refrigerator Organizer (Big)
description: 8 litre clear fridge organizer with a lid and handle, for bread, fruit and vegetables.

name: DSP 2-in-1 Stand Mixer 4.0L KM-3058
description: DSP hand mixer with a 4 litre stainless steel bowl on a stand. Use it on the stand or lift it off as a hand mixer. Comes with beaters and dough hooks.

name: Piggy Bank
description: My Wish House piggy bank shaped like a little house. Coins and notes go in the slots on top, and the front door opens with the key included. Pink or blue.

name: Two-Layer Rack (Big)
description: Double-layer microwave rack. The microwave sits underneath and two shelves above hold an air fryer, toaster, rice cooker or jars.

name: One-Layer Rack (Small)
description: Single-layer microwave rack with hooks for utensils. Frees up counter space for a microwave, rice cooker or air fryer.

name: Foldable Bucket 13L
description: Foldable silicone bucket with a lid. About 36 cm across when open, and it folds down to 6.5 cm for storage.

name: Toilet Rack (Large)
description: Over-the-toilet storage rack with shelves for toiletries, towels and cleaning supplies.

name: CNTRONIC 2-in-1 Swallow Maker 8L CIC-18
description: CNTRONIC 8 litre 2-in-1 swallow maker for preparing fufu, banku and other swallow at home.

name: Ottoman Storage Bench
description: Fabric ottoman storage bench with a padded lid. Sit on it, and store blankets, shoes or toys inside. Colours vary.

name: Cloth Drying Rack
description: Indoor clothes drying rack with three tiers, fold-out wings and wheels. Size 65 × 55 × 168 cm.

name: Raf Automatic Ice Cream Machine
description: RAF automatic ice cream machine for soft-serve ice cream at home. Red or cream.

name: Squeeze Mop
description: Twist mop with thick microfibre strips. Twist the handle to wring it out without touching the dirty water.

name: 4-Step Ladder
description: Aluminium 4-step ladder with a wood-grain finish. Folds flat for storage.

name: 5-Step Ladder
description: Aluminium 5-step ladder with wide steps and edge guards. Folds flat for storage.

name: 3-Step Ladder
description: Steel 3-step folding ladder with a padded handrail and non-slip feet.

name: Gas Cooker
description: 50 × 50 cm standing cooker with three gas burners, one electric hot plate and an oven.
